market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues into Trump-Xi meeting; oil weakness supports equities but diesel record and Fed hike cap upside. Chip stocks may see profit-taking after AMD $1T milestone. Crypto momentum at 8-month highs could extend but is vulnerable to any geopolitical reversal. Watch for BofA's revised S&P 500 target as a near-term anchor.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish but concentration risk demands diversification. Critical metals supply chain nationalization is a multi-year theme. Fed's hawkish pivot on sticky inflation suggests higher-for-longer rates, pressuring valuations. China's biomedical and chip self-sufficiency blueprints create long-term competitive dynamics. Retirement/tax planning windows (Medicare gap) offer tactical allocation opportunities for fixed-income investors.
